blocks.text: This itinerary brings together cities, history, local traditions and nature. You spend the first four days in Bogotá and the surrounding area, getting to know the capital through its coffee, its historic centre and a trip out to Guatavita and Zipaquirá. From there, each move brings a change of scene, from the green hills around Guatapé to the Caribbean Sea. Along the way, you'll explore colonial quarters, see Botero's art, hear the legend of El Dorado and visit one of Colombia's best-known rock formations. You'll also get to know the street culture of Comuna 13 and see Cartagena's fortresses. A day devoted to coffee offers a hands-on introduction to one of Colombia's most important products.
